Name: Milestones of Stardew Valley - Community Center
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][color=#AAAAAA][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45871/45871-1777994854-430969051.png[/img][/color][/center]
[center][heading]🌿✨ Milestones of Stardew Valley - Community Center ✨🌿[/heading]
Welcome to a deeper, more rewarding Community Center experience! 🏡💛
[b]Milestones of Stardew Valley - Community Center[/b] transforms your restoration journey into something more meaningful, with immersive progression rewards and personalized letters from Mayor Lewis himself 📜👨‍🌾
Instead of simply completing bundles, each milestone now feels like a true achievement that the entire town recognizes 🌟
[line]
[heading]🌱 📬 Features[/heading]
[list]
🏆 Milestone-based progression system for the Community Center ✉️ Unique letters from Mayor Lewis for each completed area 🌾 Enhanced immersion and sense of town progression 💰 Reward-focused restoration feedback 🌍 Full multi-language support 🧩 Lightweight and compatible with most mods[/list][line]
[heading]📜 💛 What changes?[/heading]
Every major step in restoring the Community Center now triggers a special letter acknowledging your impact on Pelican Town’s recovery 🏡✨
The town doesn’t just improve — it [i]remembers your effort[/i].
[line]
[heading]👀 🔓 Curious? (Spoilers below)[/heading]
[spoiler]Each milestone includes a personalized letter:
[list]
🥕 Pantry → Food supply improvement acknowledgment 🎣 Fish Tank → Ecosystem restoration notice 🔥 Boiler Room → Infrastructure recovery report 📋 Bulletin Board → Community unity appreciation 💎 Vault → Financial contribution recognition 🏆 Full Completion → Official town-wide gratitude letter from Mayor Lewis[/list][/spoiler]
[line]
[heading]⚙️ 🧩 Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
Works with most Content Patcher setups Safe to add mid-save No gameplay rebalance, purely immersive expansion[/list][line]
[heading]💬 💡 Final Note[/heading]
This mod is designed to make your journey feel more alive — every bundle matters, every step is remembered 🌿✨[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color]

[size=5][b]🌍Languages Supported [/b][/size]

🇺🇸 English
🇧🇷 Portuguese
🇪🇸 Spanish
🇫🇷 French
🇩🇪 German
🇮🇹 Italian
🇷🇺 Russian
🇨🇳 Chinese
🇯🇵 Japanese
🇰🇷 Korean
🇹🇷 Turkish
🇭🇺 Hungarian
[/center]
[center][size=4]🌍✨ [b]Automatic Translation Support[/b] ✨🌍[/size]

This mod includes [b]automatic language detection[/b] 📖⚙️ 
It will automatically switch to the language currently used in your game — no manual configuration needed!

✔ Works seamlessly with supported languages 
✔ No extra setup required 
✔ Fully integrated with the game’s localization system 🌿[/center]
[center]
[color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA] 
[size=5][b]⚙️ → Installation ← ⚙️[/b][/size][/color][/center]

[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]1. [/b]⬇️ Download the mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]Nexus Mods[/url] (the only place I upload—if you found it elsewhere, run 🏃). [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]2.[/b] 📦 Drop the ZIP file into your Stardew Valley [i]Mods[/i] folder. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]3.[/b] 🧠 Extract it there like a civilized human being. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]4. [/b]🚀 Launch the game using SMAPI. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]5. [/b]🎉 Enjoy your new social life![/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=5][b]🗑️ → Uninstall ← 🗑️[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]1.[/b] 🧹 Delete the mod folder from your [i]Mods[/i] directory.[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]2.[/b] 💔 Go back to Nexus Mods and tell me why you left me (optional, but emotionally impactful). [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]3.[/b] 😢 I’ll pretend I’m fine. [/color]
[color=#AAAAAA][b]4. [/b]🌾 Go enjoy Stardew Valley without me… I guess.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]────────────────────────────────────[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=5][b]🔄 → Update ← 🔄[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]1.❗ Delete the old version (yes, really—don’t be lazy).[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA]2. 📥 Install the new version following the steps above.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA][b]⚠️ Important:[/b]
 Do [b]NOT[/b] overwrite files. That’s how chaos begins 💀
 Delete first, then install the update like a responsible adult.[/color][/center]
